glosses: pencil lead, refill, ballpoint pen reservoir (tube)

examples.text: Es war sehr dunkel in der Mine.
examples.en: It was very dark inside the mine.

examples.text: In der Mine brach ein Feuer aus.
examples.en: A fire broke out in the mine.

examples.text: Wertvolle Mineralien findet man in Minen.
examples.en: A mine is where you find precious minerals.

examples.text: Die Mehrheit der Männer arbeitete in der Mine.
examples.en: The majority of those men worked in the mine.

examples.text: Die Arbeiter stiegen in jener Nacht nicht in die Mine.
examples.en: The workmen didn't go down into the mine that night.
